title: Foundation Resource Reference
description: Stable, read-only reference to a resource owned by another module. It does not transfer resource ownership.

x-field-purposes.refId: Identify the resource in its owner namespace.
x-field-purposes.refVersion: Pin an optional immutable resource revision.
x-field-purposes.locator: Provide an optional read-only lookup locator.
x-field-purposes.digest: Bind the reference to an optional content fingerprint.

refType.description: Stable resource kind, such as dataset, semantic-version, action-request, or report.

refId.description: Stable identifier assigned by the resource owner.

relation.description: Optional relationship from the envelope to the resource.

digest.description: Optional content fingerprint supplied by the owner.
